newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai police rescue hundreds of tourists from ferry.
newsitem.headline: Thai police rescue hundreds of tourists from ferry.

text.p: Naval and marine police rescue teams in southern Thailand rescued hundreds of tourists stranded aboard a sinking ferry on Sunday, police said.

About 600 tourists were in the 2,000-tonne ferry, on their way to Phi Phi island in the Andaman sea from Phuket province about 870 km (540 miles) south of Bangkok, when the vessel hit rocks and capsized, the police said.
The incident took place about 24 km (15 miles) offshore.
Some of the European and Asian tourists had jumped off the ferry before rescue teams arrived, the police said.
They said some passengers suffered minor injuries but all the passengers were now safe.
